name: maybe_Ui_BattleTargetWindow_Init
signature: void maybe_Ui_BattleTargetWindow_Init(TargetWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 mode)
summary: Initialises four 0x470-byte target panes (HP gauge widgets, member slots, state text) and formats the state label from the battle state; body is damaged so the exact init semantics stay uncertain.
evidence: Loop over 4 panes calling Battle_HpGaugeWindow_SetMember/UpdateShake and Ui_TextElement_SetString; halt_baddata truncation; no named callers.

name: maybe_Ui_Row_Apply
signature: void maybe_Ui_Row_Apply(UiRow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Re-applies a row's columns from the cached 0x30-byte record: compares column ids with the selection and updates panes/colours via item/spell description helpers.
evidence: Callers Ui_TsuyosaWindow_FillRowsA/B and Ui_Row_Reset; loop over 0x12 columns with Ui_Message_GetItemDescription/GetSpellDescription; damaged control flow.

name: maybe_Ui_FieldActionListWindow_Init
signature: void maybe_Ui_FieldActionListWindow_Init(UiWindow* self, void* owner, u32 arg3, int arg4)
summary: Allocates and creates an action animation entry, sorts the actor action list by priority and attaches nut/other action nodes; heavily damaged prologue makes the window identity unproven.
evidence: Calls Battle_ActionAnimEntry_Create, Actor_ActionList_SortByPriority, Field_CreateActionNut, Container_SlotReplace; damaged prologue with unaff_r7 and bogus vtable 0x706D756A; no callers.

name: maybe_Party_UpdateMemberHpDisplay
summary: Per-frame party status pass reading member status bits and pushing clamped HP values into display widgets, lazily creating status widgets and setting colours.
evidence: Calls Party_CountAliveMembers/Party_GetActiveMemberDataByIndex, reads member+0xDA bits, checks UI overlay mode byte +0x281; no named callers.

name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_ApplySpeakerGauge
summary: Refreshes message-window speaker state: finds the party member, clamps a value against the member's remaining value, applies text colours and plays UI animation 0x27->0x28/0x29.
evidence: Calls Ui_ApplyTextColor/Alt, Message_SetArg, Ui_Widget_SetupAnimTransition(0x27,0x28/0x29), Party_GetActiveMemberDataByIndex; callers are unrelated (Camera/Gfx) so the gauge half is unconfirmed.

name: maybe_Field_ActorFocusSequence_UpdateStaged
summary: Staged actor focus sequence advancing a stage counter (+0xC92/+0xC93), toggling actor flag bits via vtable and applying frame-box helpers to actors.
evidence: Stage constants 0x6EB/0x6C9/0x6F2, vtable dispatch, calls Battle_Ui_* and Ui_BattleTargetMarker_*; damaged dispatch and no callers.

name: maybe_Ui_RecipeBook_Ctor
signature: void maybe_Ui_RecipeBook_Ctor(UiRecipeBook* self, u32 kind, u32 arg3, int argument)
summary: Constructor of the recipe-book object: stores vtable 0x75B3CC, loads training message tables, builds entry/state and fills party entries and trailing UI lists.
evidence: Vtable 0x75B3CC, calls Ui_RecipeBook_FillPartyEntries, Ui_TrainingMessage_LoadTables, Ui_TrainingWindowPart_Ctor; caller maybe_Menu_TalkParty_CreatePanel; damaged control flow.

name: maybe_Ui_List_BuildRowRecord
signature: void maybe_Ui_List_BuildRowRecord(u8* out, const u8* id, u32 mode, u32 flag)
summary: Builds a 0x84-byte name+count+icon row record: resolves the name via game tables, applies override table, measures text and picks a count via Item_PickRandomByCategory.
evidence: Calls std_wcsncpy/wcsncat, Item_PickRandomByCategory, GetSmallMedalNum; callers are Field_SceneObject/Gimmick maybes, so owning widget unproven.

name: maybe_Resource_BuildDependencyTree
signature: void maybe_Resource_BuildDependencyTree(ResContainer* self, int parent, u32 def, u32 depth)
summary: Cross-subsystem walker that resolves a data row for an id, allocates a 0x18-byte node under the parent, loads the matching pack and recurses into child id records; callers span battle, field and UI so the exact resource class is unclear.
evidence: Callers include BattleScene_RegisterUnitAbilities, Field2D_Map_PlayChipEffect, FieldParty_Ui_RefreshMemberSlot and XXO; callees Mem_AllocAligned_2, Game_GetDataManager, Battle_PartsEffect_LoadPack; node vtable 0xFFFFF000.

name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_ReleaseChildren
summary: Teardown helper that stores the class vtable, frees the handle at +0x2078/+0x207C and releases the child chain (message pages, text elements, panel, animation) at +0x20D0.
evidence: Body stores vtable and calls Pack_FreeHandleEntry/Pack_ReleaseHandle, Ui_MessagePage_Dtor, Ui_LayoutRef_Release, Ui_Object_DtorBase, std_destroy_range; no named callers to confirm the MessageWindow class.

name: maybe_Ui_BigGrid_Teardown
summary: No dossier or readable body available, so the grid teardown guess cannot be checked.
evidence: No dossier (no readable file); name retained from prior batch.

name: maybe_Ui_GridCursor_ApplySelection
signature: void maybe_Ui_GridCursor_ApplySelection(UiGridController* grid, int allow, u32 delta, u32* out)
summary: Reads the current cell/index through the controller's +0x58/+0x5C virtuals and writes the new index/cell count to the caller's output while releasing the previous owner; body is damaged and short.
evidence: Only named caller is Ui_MemoriesWindow_HandleInput; body ends in bad instruction data with dropped output contract.

name: Anim_Resource_ReleaseAndReset
summary: Releases the animation resource handle at +4 through the pack handle table and resets the slot (handle -1, type byte +8 = 0x10, five state words cleared).
evidence: Callers are Anim_Instance_ApplyTemplate, Anim_ClipSet_PlayByName, Anim_Resource_Bind and Ui_ReleaseTwoSubObjects, all animation resource users; body frees handle and zeroes state words.

name: maybe_Ui_Drawable_ReleaseMembers
summary: Damaged Thumb teardown that releases the 0xD88 reference, list heads/nodes, containers and sub-objects; exact member set cannot be confirmed.
evidence: Body uses unaff_r4/r5/r7 and dropped argument registers with a removed unreachable block; no named callers.

name: maybe_Ui_LocationWindow_ReleaseChild
summary: Deleting destructor of a child object: releases the handle at +0x16C, destroys the element at +0x11C and frees the block.
evidence: Body stores vtable, frees handle via Pack_FreeHandleEntry/Pack_ReleaseHandle, calls Ui_LayoutRef_Release and a free helper; no named callers to confirm the LocationWindow class.

name: maybe_Actor_SyncModelTransform
signature: void maybe_Actor_SyncModelTransform(unsigned int actor_id, unsigned int* handle)
summary: Resolves the model bound to an actor handle and copies the actor's world transform (rotation matrix + position) onto it.
evidence: Callees Model_BindResourceSlots, Model_Node_ComposeMatrix and Battle_Ui_UpdatePartyPanelSequence support transform copy; caller 0x00602F00 BattleScene_SetBackgroundLayer and handle table g_005A5598 remain raw.

name: maybe_Ui_LocationWindow_CreateChild
summary: Installs the location-banner vtable and constructs the animation-ref element at +0x11C with the given style, returning the banner base.
evidence: Only caller Ui_SubObject_Create; callees Ui_AnimRefList_Ctor and Ui_Widget_ApplyScreenTransform; vtable pair 0x7682DC/0x7682E0 supports a banner child but role unproven.

name: maybe_Battle_SceneNode_Ctor
summary: Constructor of a small battle-scene node: installs vtable 0x76EF7C, sets id=0xFFFF/payload=0 pairs and float 256.0, and initialises flag bytes.
evidence: Called three times from maybe_Battle_SceneInit_Shared; body installs a vtable and initialises fields; no monster-pattern link.

name: maybe_Ui_Plate_FormatFullDescriptor
summary: Formats a full UTF-16 detail string for a spell/skill/item record, resolving through Ui_Message_GetSpellDescription or Ui_Message_GetItemDescription and copying into the caller's buffer.
evidence: Many named callers (Ui_SkillPanel_UpdateSkillDescription, Ui_ItemRows_RefreshRows, Ui_PlateWidget_BindEntry); callees include both description getters and std_wcsncpy; plate widget attribution still inferred.

name: maybe_Ui_PokerWindow_SetSelectedItem
signature: void maybe_Ui_PokerWindow_SetSelectedItem(PokerWindow* self, int cardIdx, int value)
summary: Selects the prize/card item at the given index: reads the card list, resolves the item with Item_LookupRecord, writes self fields and message argument 5, and updates UI number fields.
evidence: Callers Ui_PokerWindow_Confirm/Cancel/HandlePayout; callees Item_LookupRecord, Message_SetArg, Ui_PrizeWindow_Init; body writes selected item/cost/label.

name: maybe_Ui_EquipRow_UpdateCompareText
signature: void maybe_Ui_EquipRow_UpdateCompareText(EquipRow* row, u32 memberId, u32 slot, int count)
summary: Formats the member's item at the given inventory slot as message argument 6 and continues the equipment comparison, reaching the equip animation and member item-slot setters.
evidence: Callees Text_FormatMessageArg, Message_SetArg, Item_LookupRecord, Member_SetItemAtSlot, Member_SwapInventorySlots, Ui_EquipmentWindow_PlayAnim; equip-row class inferred.

name: maybe_Battle_SetMemberStatMessageArgs
summary: Resolves the party member behind the actor's character id, runs the Party_StatCalc member-stat pass, copies the resulting 0x3C0 block and fills message argument slots 8..14.
evidence: Callees Party_StatCalc_InitContext/SetupMemberContext/ApplyBaseStats, std_memcpy and Message_FormatArgSlot_ResetC(8..14); no named callers.

name: maybe_Ui_PokerWindow_StoreCard
signature: void maybe_Ui_PokerWindow_StoreCard(PokerWindow* self, int cardIdx, int arg3, int context)
summary: Damaged Thumb fragment: surviving calls store the chosen card/item id and price into window state, look the item up and set message argument 5.
evidence: Body has unaff_r4..r8 and lost operands; only Item_LookupRecord, func_0066B41C, Message_SetArg(5) and the 0xA19 item range survive.

name: maybe_Ui_ProfileWindow_RefreshStats
summary: Refreshes the value panes of a profile card: formats play time and per-title counters, binds matching icons and writes the icon of the currently selected title.
evidence: Caller Ui_TsuyosaWindow_ApplyModeRecord; callees Message_FormatArgSlot_ResetB, Ui_Pane_PlayLayoutAnim, Ui_GetCore; profile-window attribution inferred from title/play-time strings.

name: maybe_Ui_CheckListWindow_RefreshRows
summary: Fills six rows of a page from the u16 id list, resolving each id with 0x0063E998 and Item_LookupRecord, formatting row text via Text_FormatMessageArg, and toggling row visibility/check flags from the ownership bitmask at work+0x2A2C8.
evidence: The 'Check' in the name is part of the CheckListWindow class noun, not a predicate verb: the function returns void and its body only writes row text and flag bytes (self+0x140/0x152/0x153/0x154/0x155), never returning a boolean. Ghidra's dropped-return trap does not apply because the last statements are stores, not a getter call whose result is discarded. Callees Item_LookupRecord, Text_FormatMessageArg, Game_GetWork and Game_GetDataManager confirm a list-window row refresh, but no named caller proves the window class, so the maybe_ prefix and low confidence stay.

name: maybe_Ui_MedalPrizeWindow_SetItemText
summary: Resolves the given id to an item-storage pointer, formats it into the shared message buffer and sets the label pane image to resource 0x1F.
evidence: Item_GetStoragePointer + Ui_GetCore + pane image 0x1F; callers Ui_Casino_SetRowFlagForItem and Ui_ItemScreen_ShowItemInfo are item-display code.

name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_PreparePage
summary: Prepares a message window page: looks up item 0x2C, stores its name-plate window, formats work+0x2A2C4 and the plate into the shared buffer, and sets page-nav callbacks based on counters.
evidence: Item_LookupRecord(0x2C), Ui_Slot_BindControl, page-nav callback table; owning window not proven.

name: maybe_Ui_MessageQueue_Pop
summary: Pops the head of a small queue: formats the entry's three u16 ids as message arguments 5..7 and shifts the 0xE0-byte entry block down one slot.
evidence: Message_SetArg(5..7) loop over 3 ids plus a block-shift loop; no named caller identifies the owner.

name: maybe_Ui_MedalPrizeWindow_SetCounterText
summary: Shows a decimal counter on the prize window: formats work+0x27C7C into the shared buffer and sets the label pane image to resource 0x21.
evidence: Caller Ui_MedalPrizeWindow_Ctor; same pane-image sequence as the sibling prize-window setters.

name: maybe_Ui_Window_FlushAndShowStateMessage
signature: void maybe_Ui_Window_FlushAndShowStateMessage(void* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 ctx)
summary: Drains the window's pending queue, then shows a state-dependent system message (state 3 uses message 0x11, otherwise 0x10 with state+1) and finally message 0x2E in the sub-pane.
evidence: Queue-drain loop plus fixed message ids 0x11/0x10/0x2E; owning window not identified.

name: maybe_Ui_NumberPane_SetIconAndText
summary: Refreshes a number pane: formats work+0x2A2C4 into the shared buffer and sets the pane's string from text id 0x1F.
evidence: Only Ui_GetCore/Game_GetWork and the generic pane setter; caller Ui_SmithMenu_ExecuteCommand does not confirm the pane class.

name: maybe_Ui_MedalPrizeWindow_SetProductText
summary: Writes the prize window's product text: formats the count with '%d' into the first pane and count*unitPrice with '%02d' into pane 1 (UI key 0x21).
evidence: Callers Ui_PokerWindow_Confirm and Ui_PokerWindow_HandlePayout; '%02d' literal and pane-image 0x21 sequence.

name: maybe_Container_InlineSlot_PopFront
summary: Pops the head of a small inline container: returns the old key, logs it through the trace formatter, slides the 0x20-byte payload down with memmove and clears the counter.
evidence: Body matches the documented pop-front (return +4, memmove 0x20, clear +0x24); no named callers and the trace formatter is unnamed, so the container reading stays inferred.

name: maybe_Field_Actor_NotifyAnimUpdate
summary: Ensures the global animation object and registers its result with the UI core (core+0x848, callback id 0x640025), rebinding core+0x844.
evidence: No callers, no recovered parameters, and 0x640025 is an opaque core callback id; only the Anim_GlobalObject_Ensure callee ties it to animation.

name: maybe_Effect_CreateMeshEmitterPair
summary: Creates a sprite actor from the spawn params, allocates the 0x178 mesh instance, attaches a sprite anim instance and sets the model size.
evidence: Only caller Field_SceneObject_SpawnByTypeB; callees Gfx_SpriteActor_CreateFromTable, Anim_Instance_CtorSprite, Field_SceneObject_SetModelSize; emitter pairing is inferred.

name: maybe_Actor2D_PlayAnimOnParts
summary: Three-state animation step for a 2D actor: waits out f_298+0x14, plays the shared anim id on the two child lists, then plays anim 2 and restarts the clip after the retarget timer.
evidence: All callers unnamed and the body has unaff_/halt_baddata damage; named callees Anim_PlayByIdForActor and Sound_PlaySeById only confirm it is an animation step.

name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_CreateSpriteChild
signature: void maybe_Field_SceneObject_CreateSpriteChild(int self, void* params, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4)
summary: Creates a mesh/sprite child for a field scene object: resolves the model resource, allocates the 0x178 mesh, applies the transform, registers one child slot and sets the sprite priority.
evidence: Only caller Field_SceneObject_SpawnByTypeB; sprite-specific callees Anim_Instance_CtorSprite/ApplyTemplate, Gfx_SpriteActor_AddChild, Gfx_LookupSpritePriorityByte, Field_SceneObject_SetModelSize.

name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_CreateSpriteChildFromParams
signature: void maybe_Field_SceneObject_CreateSpriteChildFromParams(int self, short* params, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4)
summary: Sprite-child variant that reads a packed short parameter block, looks the model up through 0x0062C388/0x0062C3B0, creates the 0x178 mesh instance and finishes with the colour/position animator.
evidence: Caller Field_SceneObject_SpawnByTypeB; callees overlap sibling 0x002B3430 plus Gfx_CreateFColAnimator; the packed short param block is inferred.

name: maybe_Actor2D_BuildPartSpriteList
signature: void maybe_Actor2D_BuildPartSpriteList(void* self, u32 count, const void* partArray)
summary: Damaged Thumb fragment repeating the part-sprite loop of 0x0028EFEC: creates an Actor2D sprite per part entry, stores it in the f_2D0 array, attaches it and clears f_2D4/f_2D8/f_2DC.
evidence: All parameters arrive as unaff_rX; only the callee set (Actor2D_CreateSpriteWithDefaults, Gfx_CreateSpriteMesh, Gfx_SpriteActor_CreateFromTable) and identical epilogue tie it to 0x0028EFEC.

name: maybe_Ui_Row_SetSelected
summary: Applies a row's selected state: stores the flag at +0x4A, makes exactly one of the three selection icons visible, refreshes the row text and resets the cursor fields.
evidence: +0x4A flag, three icon toggles, Message_SetArg and func_0035EB98 member lookup match the name; caller Ui_TsuyosaWindow_UpdateSelection; body has halt_baddata damage.

name: maybe_Ui_NumPanel_BindNumPane
summary: Binds the single pane named 'num' of the passed layout to the widget at self+0x4C through Ui_AnimRef_Bind; nothing else is initialised.
evidence: Literal 'num' at 0x006D756E and Ui_AnimRef_Bind are readable, but the owning numeric-entry window is inferred from one pane and there are no callers.

name: maybe_Ui_IconButton_InitPanes
summary: Single-icon window: attaches one unnamed pane and resolves the icon widget stored in the window's name field at f_50.
evidence: Only one bind call with an inline literal and the layout child resolve (vtable+0x2C, stored at f_50) are visible; no string identifies the widget.

name: maybe_Ui_Text_IncrementDigitString
summary: Rolls a decimal digit string (used by counter/score displays) by incrementing digits with carry, seeding the local buffer from 'null_txt_0'.
evidence: 'null_txt_0' literal, '9' compares and carry propagation are explicit, but no readable caller and UI/text ownership is inferred from the literal.

name: maybe_Ui_PaneGroup_BindNullAndEmotionPanes
summary: Initialises a two-part pane group from the owner's layout: binds the pane named 'null_q' into self[1], resets the group (virtual+0x0C with 0) and then builds/binds the 'emotion_chara_q' sub-group at self+2 with Ui_AnimRef_Bind.
evidence: Both string literals ('null_q' at 0x002B21A0 and 'emotion_chara_q' at 0x002B21A8) are readable and Ui_AnimRef_Bind is named; owning class still unknown.

name: maybe_Gfx_Overlay_DrawMainScreenB
summary: Second variant of the main overlay draw pass: the same 0x2D2930/0x2D31B0/0x2D4484 submission sequence plus 0x0055DC6C, used when the overlay mode differs from 0x002D36C8.
evidence: Body is damaged (coprocessor_load/store, in_cr0/in_cr8, overlapping instructions at 0x2D43A0); only the shared callee set is clear.

name: maybe_Ui_ListWidget_Screen_Ctor
signature: UiListWidgetScreen* maybe_Ui_ListWidget_Screen_Ctor(UiListWidgetScreen* self, u32 owner, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Constructs a list-widget screen: installs vtable 0x76CF80, runs Ui_ListWidget_Ctor, initialises the list anchors and copies the owner's cached row data (0x84/0x44-byte blocks) into the new screen.
evidence: All callees named (Ui_ListWidget_Ctor, Ui_Object_CreatePartsFromTable, Ui_List_ReleaseEntries, Ui_DiveCapture_Ctor, Text_ExecuteCommand/SetCommandArgs); owner resolved through 0x007B80C0 handle table; one caller maybe_Menu_TalkParty_CreatePanel.

name: maybe_Battle_Ui_BuildTargetRows
signature: int* maybe_Battle_Ui_BuildTargetRows(int* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, int arg4)
summary: Builds the two target-candidate rows for the current command: looks up the two actor slot ids from the table at +0x1778, applies the row layout and runs the target-marker runner over both slots.
evidence: Menu_CountPartyActors, Menu_GetActorByIndex, Battle_Ui_ShowDropItemMessage and Battle_Effect_UpdateAuraEffect are named and the two-slot pairs at +0x1778 are visible, but the marker runner 0x4BEE8C is still unnamed.

name: maybe_Battle_Ui_UpdateTargetRow
summary: Target-row animation update: switches on the row ids 0x0E/0x1C, drives the marker/message row through 0x4BEE8C and moves the panel to state 0x278B/0x2799.
evidence: Same two row ids and marker runner as 0x00481B5C support the target-row reading, but the states 0x278B/0x2799 and the panel role are raw numbers with no caller.

name: Field_CreateActorResourceSet
summary: Builds a 28-byte resource-set descriptor for the actor id from vtable+0xCC, lazily allocates the 0xC0 resource-set block at self+0xE2 and initialises it via Fs_ResourceSet_InitFromRecord from data-manager +0x3E4.
evidence: Only class call is Fs_ResourceSet_InitFromRecord; descriptor flags 0x10/0x0E/count 5; called from Field_SpawnObjectRecordB/C, Field_Object_ApplySpawnRecord and NPC balloon inits; no audio calls.
